tagline: Mash on your phone. A friend in the next lane from one link. No race server.
description:
Mash the pad. Your sticker sprints down the track. First across the tape wins. Lanes sit side by side, so you can see who jumped the start — and if you mash before go, you go back.

On your phone the pad is most of the lower half. On a laptop, hit space or click the pad.

On your own, race a ghost of your best run, or a computer runner with a fair cadence — beatable if you mash, not asleep if you don't.

Want a friend in the next lane? Press Invite in the bar above the app and send the link. Two to four of you, a countdown, then mash. There is no race server, no account, and no lobby. The room is the link. The finish lives in the file.

The last second loops so you can see the nose — a photo finish, right there.
